notes.title: TrainTastic 2/7/2024 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
After some helpful feedback we wanted to keep the ball rolling and roll out some small changes:
[list]
[*] Trains are slightly bigger to make it easier to see and play
[*] Fixed slight bug with readying up being stuck to a single button
[*] General map improvements - camera angles, adjustments, better colliders, etc
[/list]

Hope you enjoy! We have some more stuff we hope to fix in our backlog, but please let us know if you find any other bugs or anything. Happy training!
